summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting progress of its common stock repurchase program authorized by the Board on May 15, 2026. The company repurchased 3,217,600 shares for JPY 24,772,914,900 (~$172M) in June 2026 via a trust method market purchase. The program authorizes up to 25M shares (1.0% of outstanding) for up to JPY 100bn (~$694M) through August 31, 2026. Cumulative repurchases as of June 30 total 5,302,700 shares for JPY 39,573,651,100. This is an open-market buyback returning capital to shareholders; monitor execution pace vs. authorized ceiling and any updates from the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
